label: PF Backlog 629
title: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn

brief.why: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn

objective: Make Gate 1.5 evidence binding at Gate 1 and cut review churn by pre-empting recurring findings: a design pre-check checklist, a Gate 1 pending-blocking check, direct-call 1.5/2.5 defaults, and a findings->correction-ledger learning loop.
acceptance_criteria: A deterministic check (scripts/dev/gate1_check.py <ID>) renders the consolidated Gate 1.5 findings+dispositions and exits non-zero when any BLOCKER or MAJOR is still PENDING.
architect_review.py gate --item <ID> --gate 1 output is required in the Gate 1 approval package and documented as binding in docs/REVIEW-GATES-LIFECYCLE.md.

A design pre-check checklist covering recurring blocker classes (reversibility/backup, availability/SPOF, authz/RLS/privilege boundary, blast radius/dry-run, id-ordering invariants, tests/rollback, language rule, API check) is emitted before a 1.5 run and recorded on the item.
Gate 1.5/2.5 default to the direct provider call (architect_review.py run); the sub-agent launch is opt-in only and both paths are documented in config/architect-review.json and docs.
Recurring findings are captured as CORRECTION-LEDGER entries each with an enforcement point, and a findings-per-review trend is reported via the RAG-PROCESS-MEMORY store.
A test covers the PENDING-blocking behaviour: Gate 1 check fails when a BLOCKER/MAJOR is undispensed and passes when all findings are dispositioned.
approach: Process: Gate 1 must embed the latest Gate 1.5 evidence + a design pre-check checklist to reduce review churn

trend reporting needs the RAG store wired
rollback: revert the tooling/doc change; the renderer already exists.

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend core/model_gate.py + core/code_quality_gate.py so Gate 1 pulls the latest /api/v1/evidence/manifest + Gate 1.5 events into its payload; add a design pre-check checklist (from config/architect-review-baseline.json + config/review-focus.json) rendered in the Gate 1 gate report via /api/v1/engineering/gates.
